segment_definition_note: Alphabet introduced 'Google Cloud' as a distinct reportable segment starting with its Q4/FY2020 earnings release (filed 2021-02-02), which recast Q4 2019 and FY2018-2020 as comparatives. Individual Q1-Q3 2019 and all 2018 quarters are NOT available at quarterly granularity (only annual totals were disclosed for those periods) -- left as gaps, not estimated. Before this reorg, cloud revenue was bundled inside 'Google other revenues'.
No further Google Cloud segment redefinition found through FY2025 10-K (GCP + Google Workspace consistently).
